problems: The base doesn't read as tall. The pedestal stops at z = 0.40 and the dish's lower rim drops to about z = 0.53, so the dish looks set straight onto a short, stubby cone.
The yoke arms and the elevation axle sit entirely behind the dish. Nothing visible holds the dish up or shows how it turns, so it looks glued onto the turntable.
The feed struts are thin, white-on-white and seen nearly flat against the shell. They read as grooves cut into the dish, not as supports standing off it to hold the feed.

The dish faces the camera almost head-on, so from this low camera it reads as a flat white disc: no bowl depth or rim profile shows, and it looks aimed at the viewer rather than tilted up to the sky. Fix: tilt the dish further up (axis 55 degrees above the horizon) and turn the hero with k.turn(0, 0, -55) so the dish faces up and to the left and its concave bowl and rim edge show.
The gray base renders almost white and blends with the white dish, so the card's 'gray base' is lost. Fix: darker grays for the pedestal, yoke and turntable.
